## Auto-update

GitHub Actions runs `.github/workflows/daily-snapshot.yml` on a daily cron; trigger manually from the Actions tab if needed.

Guild list lives in `config/guilds.json`. Investment history is in `data/members.json`; latest membership is in `data/guild-members.json`; per-guild reports go to `reports/`.
